description: This file defines a class 'TransactionCommitterAttributeMapper' that implements the 'IAttributeToFactoryMapper' interface for mapping attributes to factory methods within the Orleans Transactions framework. It handles the creation of transaction committers based on attributes and leverages reflection to invoke generically-typed methods.

classes.name: TransactionCommitterAttributeMapper
classes.description: Implements attribute to factory mapping for transaction committers, utilizing reflection to invoke generic factory creation methods based on transaction attributes.

methods.name: GetFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory function that produces transaction committers based on provided attribute and method info, using reflection to handle generic types.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Invokes the factory method to create a transaction committer, utilizing the dependency injection container and reflection.
